name: Wasps vs. Demons: A Love Story
source:
You are Toni, a demon of the House Oni, who has fallen in love with the wasp daughter of the House Hymenoptera. Her family does not approve. Convince them of their mistake and take her hand in girlfriendage. A visual novel / turn-based RPG.

Completed as a Kickstarter reward, for a donor who gave the theme "Wasps VS Demons! A love story".

[From [url=http://www.glorioustrainwrecks.com/node/2302]Glorious Trainwrecks[/url]]
translation:
你是托尼，奥尼家族的恶魔，爱上了膜翅目家族的黄蜂女儿。她的家人不同意。让他们承认自己的错误，并握住她的手，建立友谊。视觉小说/回合制角色扮演游戏。

作为Kickstarter奖励完成，奖励给主题为“黄蜂与恶魔！一个爱情故事”的捐赠者。

[来自[url=http://www.glorioustrainwrecks.com/node/2302]光荣的火车残骸[/url]]
